scope: Conservative fixed standard ambient bulk families using only existing references. Catalog completeness is not a proof of ambient uniqueness. Unqualified Al2O3/WO3/Se/S/C/P/PbO/TiO2 and other held phase families remain flat; exact own-name phase routes are separate. Original reference scope/checksums remain. No new COD/CIF/model or sample inference.
